celulas_madre.title: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
celulas_madre.description: Totipotent cells capable of converting diseased tissue into healthy tissue. Can be autologous or allogeneic

exosomas.title: Exosomes
exosomas.description: Vesicles extracted from mesenchymal stem cells containing microRNA, proteins and growth factors

prp.title: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)
prp.description: Plasma fraction extracted from autologous blood with higher platelet concentration and high levels of growth factors

acido_hialuronico.title: Hyaluronic Acid
acido_hialuronico.description: Joint lubricant that accelerates healing, promotes natural collagen production and has analgesic effects

infiltracion.title: Conventional Infiltration
infiltracion.description: Inflammation control of joint, tendon or muscle through steroids or bioregulators with local anesthetics

sueroterapia.title: IV Therapy
sueroterapia.description: Personalized intravenous formula that provides the body with necessary elements to restore balance and wellness

adelgazamiento.title: Weight Loss Program
adelgazamiento.description: Comprehensive multidisciplinary program that helps you make permanent changes in eating habits, physical activity and psychological management

alto_rendimiento.title: High Performance Sports
alto_rendimiento.description: Evaluation and management of elite and amateur athletes to prevent and rehabilitate sports injuries and improve performance in safe conditions

faqs.title: Have questions? We're here to help
faqs.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about our treatments

question1.a: Procedures are performed with local anesthesia and are minimally invasive, causing minimal discomfort.

question2.a: It depends on the treatment, but generally patients can resume normal activities in 1-2 weeks.

question3.q: Does my insurance cover these treatments?
question3.a: We work with major insurance providers. Contact your insurance to verify specific coverage.

question4.q: Do I need a medical referral?
question4.a: A referral is not necessary, you can schedule your appointment directly.

question5.q: What should I bring to my first appointment?
question5.a: Bring your previous medical tests, list of current medications, and your ID.
